engine_basis: Zend/zend_exceptions.c::Exception::__toString formats class, message, file, line, trace and previous but omits code; it writes only the receiver's private string cache. Equal formatted cache bytes can therefore hide a different inner code.

Zend/zend_object_handlers.c::zend_std_compare_objects scans the seven physical declared slots in order. The cache slot precedes code and the previous link; nested previous objects compare recursively.
scope: Normal nonpending comparison of distinct canonical live unmaterialized same-kind builtin Exception/Exception or Error/Error roots with at least one root previous link. Both previous chains are acyclic with at most 16 nodes each. Every node is nonfreeing, has a valid seven-slot physical image, allocated empty trace and physical PSTRING cache; at least one cache anywhere in either chain is nonempty. The first six slots compare before null/object or distinct previous recursion. This is an admission cap, not Zend's exact stack threshold. Nonempty traces, mixed kinds, materialized tables, pending effects and longer/cyclic chains remain outside the cut.
